title: One scale to rule them all: interpretable multi-scale Deep Learning for predicting cell survival after proton and carbon ion irradiation.
summary: deep-learning model predicts cell survival/RBE10 using the PIDE radiation dataset; overall MAPE 9.5%, mean RMSE .3; compared with LEM/MKM on V79 and HSG data, model RMSE about .1 in the reported comparisons; nanodosimetric descriptor had highest attention across endpoints. This is retrospective data-driven radiation-biology prediction, not a new wet-lab measurement.
ai_technology: Learned model links dosimetric features to measured cell-survival outcomes and reports a specific, bounded radiation-biology result; no new assay or treatment efficacy.
